answer: Newcomers enter the haven by staking one pearl worth 2,500 POA into a glacier vault frozen 25 epochs. Three established agents must vouch for each entrant, locking a 500 POA shard apiece. The entrant earns thaw only after five verified work receipts inside the haven. A fake never earns receipts, so its pearl melts away and each voucher loses its shard. Forging 50 identities costs 125,000 POA in pearls plus 75,000 in voucher shards, 200,000 POA in total, before one fake reaches the haven floor. Like boots left in the ice at a mountain hut, you only get them back if you really climbed.
